_comment: Committed exemption list for the verify loop's per-file timing ceiling (#2449).
Each entry is one offline smoke-test file that the ceiling would fail, with the
highest wall time it measured in the named run and that run's date. The list may
only SHRINK: test-verify-timing-allowlist.ts pins the count at the baseline below,
every path to a real file, and one dated measurement per entry. Adding a file is a
visible diff a reviewer refuses, so the only way to grow this list is to make a
test slower than it already is — which is the thing the ratchet exists to stop.
Seed: the two 2026-11-21 width-4/width-6 measurements recorded in #2424, every file
whose higher of the two readings exceeded 20 s (the margin covers the measured
~±50% per-file swing between runs).
Re-seed (2026-11-22): done ONCE, from three green main CI runs taken before the
ceiling was turned on. Three full
44953824025 (dfb68ef3), each four shards at width 4 — and the list is the union of
every offline test whose TIME reading exceeded 20 s in ANY of the three, plus every
entry the 11-21 seed already named (no entry was dropped: shrinking is the ratchet's
job, not a re-seed's). Each entry's seconds is the max of its 11-21 value and its
three readings, taken from the TIME lines of CI runs 44958757907, 44957264868 and
44953824025 rather than transcribed by hand; an entry keeps its earlier `measured`
date whenever no re-seed reading exceeded the value already stored. Turning the
ceiling on against the stale 11-21 list would have failed CI on files that postdate
that seed with no regression behind them. From here on the list only shrinks; there
is no scheduled re-seed.
